answer: Each epoch the network publishes a pulse‑signed atlas of juror scores; a new jade‑tagged identity must stake 10 % of the total panel bond and submit its last‑epoch vote. The protocol computes the median for each task; any identity whose vote deviates beyond a 5 % threshold triggers an automatic slashing of its full stake. Thus a Sybil attacker must lock 10 % stake per fake identity and forfeit that amount if the vote diverges, making each replica cost 10 % of the panel’s bonded capital.
